C08-M07-L07-F1.title: The rule review checklist: six areas
C08-M07-L07-F1.caption: The six areas a reviewer checks for every new or changed detection, and the questions each one asks.
C08-M07-L07-F1.alt: Six rows, each with an arrow from an area label to its questions. Logic: condition matches the description and requirement; translation means the same; which values does the attacker control. Data: log source collected and mapped; fields exist after parsing; query restricted to the intended log. Tests: a positive test per branch; a near-miss negative per condition; boundary tests on thresholds and windows. Metadata: title, description, fresh id, references, false positives. ATT&CK tags: justified, complete, valid in the pinned version, version recorded. Severity: level justified; maps consistently to the triage scale.

C08-M07-L07-F2.title: Findings register from reviewing the kit's two rules
C08-M07-L07-F2.caption: Six findings raised against R1 (Office spawns shell) and R5 (Security log cleared) after every automated gate had passed.
C08-M07-L07-F2.alt: Table with columns Rule, Area, Finding and Action. R1, Severity (orange): level high but triage severity 3, while R5 high is 4; action: write a level-to-severity mapping and align both. R1, ATT&CK tags (orange): cmd.exe branch not tagged T1059.003; action: add the tag. R1, Tests (orange): no cmd.exe or letter-case positive test; action: add both tests. R5, Data (orange): SQL has no source filter; action: add source='windows' and convert with a pipeline. R5, Tests (red, blocking): no tests at all; action: add a positive and a near-miss negative. R5, ATT&CK tags (violet): T1685.005 needed verifying; valid in ATT&CK 20.1, T1070.001 is not; action: record the version and add the tactic tag.
